scope: Three rounds produced after the FSLW / ABCD / V3-Huang upload: (A) V2 dual-height candidate expansion + strengthened R&R (752/1024); (B) pure orthogonal 90-degree geometry control (262/1024); (C) five-layer 2.5D local-lift experiment (A 820/1024, B 383/1024; 3-layer controls 788 and 342).

honesty.dual_height: z1=0.0 / z2=0.5 mm dual-height interface is a simulation assumption; glass thickness and connector mounting direction are not confirmed; the 9 mm connector pitch has unresolved mechanical interference.
honesty.no_z_transition_2d_rounds: the V2 candidate and pure-90 rounds are two independent 2D planes with no z transition; cross-plane XY projections are not same-layer conflicts.
honesty.2d5d_scope: the five-layer experiment implements only single-lift 2.5D (one climb and one descent per route); native 3D joint routing is not implemented.
honesty.loss: bend / crossing loss for the femtosecond-laser-written glass model is unknown and not calibrated; no optical performance claim is made.
honesty.manufacturability: none of the rounds claims manufacturability.

omitted.reason: heavy intermediate per-plane render products are omitted to keep the repository manageable; all of them are regenerable from the uploaded authoritative routes.json / routes_25d.json plus the reproduce commands.

code_updates.notes: the d56 updates are the newer local versions that add the strict local-crossing-window policy and the v2opt ranking hooks; the repository READMEs are updated in place (append only).
